tests.name: jev admin stats still auth-gated (gate rows surface here)

tests.reason: The tools need a signed-in exafy_admin Operator Console turn and a connected exafy.io drive; an Operator turn and an OAuth grant are writes a read-only staging probe must not cause. Account restriction, scopes, escaping, both providers, the gate's modes, input and agreement, and the staff-only wiring are proven by this suite.
